name: Sotrama Settings

fields.label: Enable Algerian Company Registration Fields
fields.description: When enabled, Sotrama adds Article d'imposition, NIS, RC and Capital Social to Company records whose Country is Algeria. NIF continues to use ERPNext's standard Tax ID field. Disabling this option hides Sotrama fields but preserves their values.

description: Central application settings and optional feature activation for all Sotrama modules.
